jtechstorage.welcome.line1: ✦ Welcome to JTechStorage! You received the Storage Handbook.
jtechstorage.welcome.line2: A vanilla-friendly storage mod by %s – have fun organizing!
jtechstorage.guide.welcome.title: Welcome!
jtechstorage.guide.welcome.body:
Glad you're here! JTechStorage connects your ordinary chests into a network – no power, no cables. On top of that: amethyst helpers, teams and trade, phoenix mail, two bosses and gear from the End.

This handbook explains the controls. Recipes, creatures, items and bosses have their own books – see "Library".

Mod by %s
jtechstorage.guide.start.title: Getting Started
jtechstorage.guide.start.body:
1. Place a Storage Terminal.
2. Shift + right-click it with a Storage Key to link.
3. Shift + right-click chests to add them.
4. Open the terminal – done!
jtechstorage.guide.upgrades.title: Upgrades
jtechstorage.guide.upgrades.body:
Range:
%s → %s → %s → %s → %s
Ender: %s, wireless unlimited

Chests:
%s → %s → %s → %s → %s

Iron tier: only from the Amethyst Robot. Then gold, diamond, netherite.
jtechstorage.guide.sorting.title: Sorting Rules
jtechstorage.guide.sorting.body:
Hang an item frame with an item on a linked chest: it will only accept that item – and gets it first.

Multiple frames = multiple items.
jtechstorage.guide.friends.title: Team Terminal
jtechstorage.guide.friends.body:
Right-click with a bound key to link it. Name, color, access, channel messages and members.

Roles: Guest (view), Member (items), Builder (+ chests/helpers), Manager (+ upgrades, team, trade).
jtechstorage.guide.recipes.title: Recipe Book
jtechstorage.guide.recipes.body:
Every recipe of the mod, sorted by chapter. Click a chapter in the contents, "☰" at the top left takes you back.

Hover over an item to see its name. With JEI, "+" moves recipes straight into the Crafting Terminal.

jtechstorage.chel.joke.8: Why doesn't the ghast like jokes? It takes everything too hard – and then it cries.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.9: What do you call a chicken that builds redstone? A cluck comparator.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.10: Why is obsidian so cool? It used to be lava and just calmed down.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.11: What does a zombie say at sunrise? "Feeling kind of warm today … oh no."
jtechstorage.chel.joke.12: My hat is a crafting table. That's why I always have something to craft on my mind.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.13: Why doesn't the skeleton play football? It has no heart for sports – and no muscles.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.14: What does the wither say to the cow? Nothing. The wither doesn't talk to steaks.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.15: Why does the blaze never catch a cold? It's running hot all year round.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.16: What do you call a slime that never stops talking? A slimy talker.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.17: Why does Steve only build with blocks? Otherwise he'd have nothing to hold on to.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.18: What's green, sneaks up on you and says "psst"? A polite creeper. Sadly, they don't exist.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.19: A diamond for a joke? Okay. The joke is: I'm keeping the diamond.

jtechstorage.peter.say.2: I used to craft torches. Now I craft safety.
jtechstorage.peter.say.3: My hammer is freshly polished. The zombies are welcome to stop by.
jtechstorage.peter.say.4: I'm still Chel. Just with more armor and less tripping.
jtechstorage.peter.say.5: The base is safe. The sprite says thanks.

jtechstorage.peter.say.7: A hero doesn't need a cape. But he looks great in one.
jtechstorage.peter.say.8: When a creeper shows up, I just say: not here, buddy.

Your helpers sleep at night (the Watch Moth during the day). With resonance in the terminal they keep working – but the Spark Beetle always sleeps at night, so charge up during the day!

Peter Chel Parker never takes a break.

jtechstorage.ashley.say.2: Dust is just glitter that gave up.

jtechstorage.ashley.say.5: My fur isn't dirty, it's well lived-in.

jtechstorage.guide.boss.body:

jtechstorage.tutorial.skipped: Tour skipped. Shift + right-click with the guide restarts it.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.0: Hey! I'm Jbartels – I built JTechStorage. Let me quickly show you what the mod can do. (Right-click me = next, Shift + right-click = skip)
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.1: The heart of the mod is the Storage Terminal. It connects your normal vanilla chests into one network – see and take everything in one place, no power needed.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.2: With the Storage Key you bind yourself to the terminal (Shift + right-click) and add chests (Shift + right-click on the chest). While you hold it, all linked chests sparkle.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.3: The Crafting Terminal refills its grid from storage after every craft. An item frame turns a chest into a sorting chest. With the Team and Trade Terminals you share your storage with friends or open a shop.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.4: The first upgrades can't be crafted – you have to earn them! Use the Resonance Igniter and defeat the Amethyst Robot. With some luck it drops an Amethyst Core – you need one for every helper.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.5: The Wireless Terminal opens your network from afar – but only with a Wireless Core. With some luck the Amethyst Robot drops that too.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.6: The Amethyst Sprite sorts your chests by category, collects dropped items, tidies chests inside and empties placed backpacks.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.7: The Watch Moth keeps watch at night: it makes monsters glow, warns you with a bell and shows Peter his targets.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.8: The Storage Griffin is your flying mount with a chest. Land within terminal range and it unloads everything.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.9: The Spark Beetle charges your terminal with resonance. Resonance is only a bonus: more range, faster helpers – and no night break.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.10: This is Chel – named after my best friend. He crafts missing items automatically. Give him a diamond for a joke … and try a nether star.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.11: Peter Chel Parker – Chel's hero form. He protects your base from monsters. With a Dragon Heart, Peter even becomes Cheldrogan, a dragon you can ride and fly.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.12: And this is Ashley. She's … well, a bit dirty. When Peter is hurt, he kicks her to heal. She (mostly) doesn't hold it against him.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.13: The Phoenix is your mail carrier: it lives in a Phoenix Nest and carries parcels from your storage straight into your friends' storage.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.14: With an Amethyst Obsidian Upgrade it becomes the Amethyst Phoenix: two seats, up to four chests. Build up to four Phoenix Stops, name them and set the order with a Flight Plan – it then flies the route on its own.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.15: Crystal Lairs float in the outer End – the Lair Compass shows the way. The Great Amethyst Spider guards them. Every victory grants an upgrade for Amethyst Obsidian gear: better than netherite, with a set bonus.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.16: Every few days the Amethyst Fox digs up an enchanted book – with crystal enchantments like Double Jump or Recall that exist nowhere else.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.17: Backpacks come in five sizes. Upgrading keeps the contents, and you can dye them, wear them on your back or place them as a block – and they pick up matching items automatically.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.18: You can recolor your helpers with dye and give them hats. And the gear button in the terminal sets the theme, accent color and size of all mod screens.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.19: That's it! All recipes and details are in the Storage Handbook. Shift + right-click with the handbook brings me back. Have fun!

jtechstorage.guide.spider.title: End Boss: Amethyst Spider
jtechstorage.guide.spider.body:
Crystal Lairs float in the outer End. The Lair Compass (right-click in the End) points to the nearest one.

On your first visit the Great Amethyst Spider awakens (600 health): venom bite, leap, crystal webs, ground spikes, shriek. Below 50 %% she calls spiderlings.

Call again: Crystal Cocoon on the altar. Loot: exactly one upgrade per victory.
jtechstorage.guide.amethyst_obsidian.bod:
Stronger than netherite, fireproof. Smithing table: upgrade + netherite item + Crystal Obsidian (one spider upgrade per piece).

Full set: +2 hearts, Fire Resistance, Haste I and Resonance Thorns – melee attackers take crystal damage back and are slowed.

jtechstorage.guide.amethyst_phoenix.body:
Right-click a phoenix with an Amethyst Obsidian Upgrade.

It visits 2–4 stops in order (see "Stops & Flight Plan") and rests at each for as long as set there. Right-click = mount (2 seats), front seat Space = leave early. Chest = add a chest (up to 4). Inventory key while riding = menu (chests, sit mode). Sneak + right-click (2×) = pack up – chests, cargo and route come along. More cargo = slower.

jtechstorage.guide.fox.title: Amethyst Fox
jtechstorage.guide.fox.body:
Place the fox and link it with a bound key. About every three days it digs in dirt, sand or gravel during the day and finds an enchanted book with a crystal enchantment – available nowhere else. The book goes into your storage.

Feeding speeds it up: glow berries −6 h, sweet berries −3 h (up to 4× per day). Sneak + right-click with an empty hand = pack up.
jtechstorage.guide.crystal_enchants.body:
Double Jump (boots, I–II): jump again in mid-air.
Sprint (leggings, I–III): faster while sprinting.
Recall (storage key): right-click into the air to return to the terminal once per day.
Careful Touch (pickaxe): mines monster spawners with their mob and budding amethyst.
Life Spark (sword/axe, I–III): melee hits heal you a little.

Only from the Amethyst Fox, apply with an anvil.
jtechstorage.guide.recipe.amethyst_fox: Amethyst Fox: digs up crystal enchantments
jtechstorage.guide.terminal.title: Using the Terminal
jtechstorage.guide.terminal.body:
Left click: stack · Right click: half · Shift-click: to inventory. Click with an item in hand: store it.

Search: name, enchantment (e.g. "sharpness v"), $enchantment, @mod, #tag. Right-click the search box to clear it.

Tabs on the left: filter by category (click the active tab again or right-click = all).

Crafting Terminal: the grid refills from storage, "×" empties it. Wireless Terminal (with Wireless Core): Shift + right-click the terminal to bind, then right-click in the air.

Statistics button (right of the hotbar): fill level, history, categories and today's changes.
jtechstorage.guide.interface.title: Interface
jtechstorage.guide.interface.body:
The gear button in the terminal (below the upgrade slots) opens the settings for all mod screens:

light or dark theme, accent color, terminal height (4–10 rows or auto) and item count size.

jtechstorage.guide.cheldrogan.body:
Dragon Heart on Peter Chel Parker: he becomes Cheldrogan, a giant amethyst dragon.

Right-click = mount. On the ground he walks, Space = take off, in the air he flies where you look. Left click = claw, R = crystal breath.

Without a rider he guards the base like Peter and heals at Ashley. Dismount far away and that becomes his new base. At 0 health he turns back into Peter.

jtechstorage.chel.joke.20: Why does the spider have so many friends? It's really well connected.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.21: What does a creeper order at a restaurant? A blast from the past.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.22: Why do chickens never visit the Nether? It's one big barbecue down there.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.23: What did the chest say to the sprite? "You see right through me."
jtechstorage.chel.joke.24: Why is the Amethyst Robot so good at math? It has a computing core.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.25: What do you call a sleeping villager? A hmmm-zzz.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.26: Why are pigs afraid of lightning? Afterwards they're always in a zombie mood.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.27: What's the enderman's favorite food? Pearl soup. It teleports straight into the stomach.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.28: I tried telling a joke about sand. It crumbled too.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.29: Why do skeletons read so much? They have a lot of spine time.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.30: What's a wolf in armor? A bark knight.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.31: Why was the pumpkin so popular? It always had a carved smile.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.32: What does the furnace say when it's done? "I'm burning for you to empty me."
jtechstorage.chel.joke.33: Why does the phoenix never play hide and seek? It always lights up.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.34: How do two redstone lamps greet each other? "You light up my day!"
jtechstorage.chel.joke.35: Why is the glow squid so happy? It always sees the light at the end of the tunnel.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.36: What does a golem do after work? It irons out its problems.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.37: Why does the bee wear a helmet? It buzzes around and sometimes hits walls.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.38: What's heavier: a ton of feathers or a ton of gravel? The gravel – it falls on your head.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.39: Why does the wither need three heads? One tells jokes, one laughs, one complains.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.40: What's the minecart's favorite song? "On the rails again."
jtechstorage.chel.joke.41: Why is the snow golem never stressed? It always keeps its cool.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.42: A zombie visits the doctor. Doctor: "You look terrible." – "Thanks, I try."
jtechstorage.chel.joke.43: Why does Ashley never have guests? She lives in a grey area.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.44: What does Peter say when he kicks Ashley? "Sorry! Just topping up."
jtechstorage.chel.joke.45: Why doesn't the griffin like elevators? It prefers to wing it.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.46: What do you call a chest full of jokes? A laugh box.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.47: Why is the spark beetle always so charged up? Too much coffee. And redstone.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.48: What's a horse without a saddle? A stable problem.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.49: Why don't endermen wear glasses? They don't need to stare any better.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.50: What does the fox do with enchanted books? It digs for punchlines.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.51: Why was the amethyst spider so fancy? It wore crystal fishnets.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.52: How many sprites does it take to place a torch? None. They only sort.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.53: Why are villagers bad comedians? Every punchline is just "hmm".
jtechstorage.chel.joke.54: What does a cow shout in the Nether? "Moo-ve, it's hot!"
jtechstorage.chel.joke.55: Why can't creepers paint? Every picture ends with a bang.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.56: What did the anvil say to the sword? "You're looking sharp today!"
jtechstorage.chel.joke.57: Why does the llama have no friends? It always spits out big words.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.58: What do you call a very slow arrow? A sloth with feathers.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.59: Why was the ore so sad? It felt completely mined out.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.60: What does an axolotl do at a job interview? It just smiles – and gets hired.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.61: Why do witches never go to the hairdresser? They brew it themselves.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.62: What's the ender dragon's favorite color? Purple. Like everything here, to be fair.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.63: Why is the compass always in a good mood? It knows where it's going.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.64: What did the hopper say to the chest? "I'll always fill you in."
jtechstorage.chel.joke.65: Why does the turtle love music? It always keeps a shell-shocking beat.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.66: What's a spark beetle in a thunderstorm? Overjoyed. And overcharged.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.67: Why does the phoenix always get mail? It's a hot topic.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.68: What do you call a diamond with humor? A carat-cter.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.69: Why do dripstones never fall? They do. Watch your head.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.70: What does Jbartels do when he's bored? He builds a new helper. Like me.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.71: Why does Cheldrogan have back crystals? So he sparkles while flying. Bit vain, that one.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.72: What's an end stone in a bathtub? Still an end stone. But clean.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.73: Why do crystals laugh so much? Everything is crystal clear to them.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.74: Last joke for today: I'm out of jokes. Give me a diamond anyway.

jtechstorage.guide.phoenix_stops.title: Stops & Flight Plan
jtechstorage.guide.phoenix_stops.body:
1. Build Phoenix Stops (up to 4) and right-click to name them. That is also where you set the rest time: 30 seconds, 5 minutes or one night.
2. Click the stops with a Flight Plan in the order you want.
3. Right-click in the air: reorder or remove stops.
4. Right-click the Amethyst Phoenix with the Flight Plan.

It lands on top of the blocks, visits the stops in order and then starts over.

Delivery order: put chests or barrels right next to the stop and pick Unload, Load or Both in its window. Up to 9 filters decide which items – and, with the scroll wheel, how many per visit.

jtechstorage.guide.chronicle.title: Crystal Chronicle
jtechstorage.guide.chronicle.body:
Deep within amethyst sleeps an ancient resonance. Whoever wakes it meets guardians of crystal – and treasures stronger than netherite.

This chronicle tells the legend and covers the bosses, Amethyst Obsidian, the crystal enchantments and the evolutions of the helpers.
jtechstorage.guide.legend.title: The Resonance
jtechstorage.guide.legend.body:
Amethyst sings. Listen closely and you'll notice it in every shard – a quiet hum that connects things.

The helpers were born from this resonance: small creatures with a core of pure amethyst. But the resonance also created guardians. The Amethyst Robot sleeps until a Resonance Igniter wakes it. And in the outer End, in floating crystal lairs, the Great Amethyst Spider lurks above the most precious material of all: Amethyst Obsidian.
jtechstorage.guide.evolutions.title: Evolutions
jtechstorage.guide.evolutions.body:
Chel → Peter Chel Parker: right-click Chel with a nether star.

Peter → Cheldrogan: right-click Peter with a Dragon Heart. At 0 health Cheldrogan turns back into Peter, and Peter into Chel.

Phoenix → Amethyst Phoenix: right-click a phoenix with an Amethyst Obsidian Upgrade.

Owner and network are kept with every evolution.
jtechstorage.guide.roadmap.title: Roadmap
jtechstorage.guide.roadmap.body:
1. Terminal, key, first chests.
2. Build a Resonance Igniter, defeat the Amethyst Robot: iron upgrades, Amethyst and Wireless Cores.
3. First helpers: sprite, moth, griffin, beetle, Chel, Ashley.
4. Team and Trade Terminals, phoenix mail.
5. Evolve Chel into Peter with a nether star.
6. Find a crystal lair in the End and defeat the Great Amethyst Spider.
7. Amethyst Obsidian gear, Amethyst Phoenix, Amethyst Fox.
8. Dragon Heart: Cheldrogan.

jtechstorage.lexicon.storage_terminal: The heart of your network. It lists the items of all linked chests with search, category tabs and sorting. Upgrades go into the terminal's slots and raise range and chest count.
jtechstorage.lexicon.crafting_terminal: A Storage Terminal with a 3×3 grid. Ingredients are refilled from storage, "×" puts everything back. With JEI, "+" transfers whole recipes.
jtechstorage.lexicon.team_terminal: Manages the team of a network: name, color, access, members with roles (Guest to Owner) and channel messages in chat.
jtechstorage.lexicon.trade_terminal: A shop with six "goods for price" offers. Goods come from your storage, payment goes into it – even while you're offline.
jtechstorage.lexicon.phoenix_nest: The mail address of a storage. The phoenix lives here: pick a destination, place items, send. Parcels for you land in storage.
jtechstorage.lexicon.phoenix_stop: A landing spot for the Amethyst Phoenix. Every stop needs a name and has its own rest time: 30 seconds, 5 minutes or one night. With a delivery order, the phoenix exchanges items with the chests right next to it when it lands – unload, load or both, optionally filtered and with an amount per visit.
jtechstorage.lexicon.crystal_altar: Stands in the heart of every crystal lair in the End. A Crystal Cocoon on it summons the Great Amethyst Spider again.
jtechstorage.lexicon.storage_key: Your most important tool: it binds to a terminal, adds chests and links helpers and extra terminals to the network.
jtechstorage.lexicon.wireless_terminal: Opens your storage from afar. Only works with a Wireless Core installed. With an Ender upgrade in the terminal it reaches everywhere – even other dimensions.
jtechstorage.lexicon.flight_plan: Sets the route of the Amethyst Phoenix: up to four named stops in any order. In its window (right-click in the air) you reorder or remove stops.
jtechstorage.lexicon.leather_backpack: Backpacks come in five tiers from 9 to 54 slots. Wear them in the chest slot, dye them and place them as a block. Items that are already inside get picked up automatically.
jtechstorage.lexicon.amethyst_draught: The Resonance Igniter wakes the Amethyst Robot. Only use it once you're well equipped!
jtechstorage.lexicon.lair_compass: Points to the nearest crystal lair in the End, home of the Great Amethyst Spider.
jtechstorage.lexicon.crystal_cocoon: Placed on the Crystal Altar, it summons the Great Amethyst Spider again – for another Amethyst Obsidian Upgrade.
jtechstorage.lexicon.amethyst_core: The core of every helper. Not craftable – only dropped by the Amethyst Robot.
jtechstorage.lexicon.wireless_core: Rare loot from the Amethyst Robot. Crafted together with the Wireless Terminal, it makes it ready to use.
jtechstorage.lexicon.dragon_heart: Pulsing with power. Turns Peter Chel Parker into Cheldrogan, the amethyst dragon.
jtechstorage.lexicon.crystal_obsidian: Ingredient for Amethyst Obsidian gear and the Dragon Heart – and repair material for the gear.
jtechstorage.lexicon.iron_range_upgrade: Range upgrades enlarge the radius in which chests can be linked: iron, gold, diamond, netherite. The iron tier only drops from the Amethyst Robot.
jtechstorage.lexicon.iron_capacity_upgra: Capacity upgrades raise the number of linkable chests (a double chest counts once). The iron tier only drops from the Amethyst Robot.
jtechstorage.lexicon.ender_range_upgrade: The highest tier: 128 blocks of range, and the Wireless Terminal works without limits and from any dimension.
jtechstorage.lexicon.amethyst_obsidian_c: Amethyst Obsidian armor is stronger than netherite and fireproof. With all four pieces: +2 hearts, Fire Resistance, Haste I and Resonance Thorns.
jtechstorage.lexicon.amethyst_obsidian_p: Amethyst Obsidian tools and the sword beat netherite in speed and damage. Made at the smithing table from their netherite counterpart.
jtechstorage.lexicon.guide_book: Basics and controls of the mod. Sneak + right-click restarts Jbartels' tour.
